# Soul and Streusel

> > A Middle Eastern and Hawaiian-inspired recipe blog celebrating soul-searching through desserts, baking, and global cuisine with a focus on dietary flexibility.

Soul and Streusel is a recipe blog based in Jerusalem that specializes in creative desserts and baked goods drawing from Middle Eastern, Moroccan, and Hawaiian culinary traditions. The site features extensive recipe collections with options for vegan, dairy-free, and dietary-restricted preparations, alongside holiday-specific and cultural recipes.

## Key Topics

- desserts
- baking
- vegan recipes
- dairy-free
- Middle Eastern cuisine
- Hawaiian recipes
- cheesecake

- recipe blog
- Jerusalem
- chocolate
- plant-based baking
- cultural recipes

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://soulandstreusel.com): Soul searching & streusel making in the heart of the Middle East - main entry point featuring Middle Eastern, Moroccan, and Hawaiian cuisine
- [Recipe Index](https://soulandstreusel.com/recipe-index): Comprehensive recipe directory organized by desserts, dietary needs, and cuisines
- [About](https://soulandstreusel.com/about-2): About page describing Soul and Streusel's mission and recipe philosophy
